name: The END Fund
summary: Funds and supports programs against neglected tropical diseases, including mass deworming for schistosomiasis and soil-transmitted worms.

spending.source: https://res.cloudinary.com/dhz4p1h5s/images/v1750852316/END-Fund_2024-Annual-Report-Single-Page/END-Fund_2024-Annual-Report-Single-Page.pdf (END Fund Annual Report 2024, Financial Summary: consolidated US and UK program services $71,212,371 of $79,095,943 total expenses; the US Form 990 alone shows $66,987,920 of $74,181,557)

lines.label: Programmes against six neglected tropical diseases (grants to implementing partners and governments, technical support)
lines.source: https://res.cloudinary.com/dhz4p1h5s/images/v1750852316/END-Fund_2024-Annual-Report-Single-Page/END-Fund_2024-Annual-Report-Single-Page.pdf (same page as the spending: the accounts give one programme service; the annual report lists grants by country, not by disease, so deworming cannot be split from the other diseases)
